description: IEEEtran V1.8b (2015/08/26, CTAN/MiKTeX) in its IEEE Computer Society journal format: journal is the class default, named here as the CTAN bare_jrnl_compsoc.tex template names it, and compsoc switches on the Computer Society layout (Palatino text, sans-serif headings and abstract, arabic section numbers, footnote marks without superscripts). It is two columns by default, so only setup A applies, and it needs no preamble: the class requires no metadata commands and checks no engine that XeTeX fails.
